Dana —

Thanks for the clear ask. Short answer: yes, we offer two pragmatic paths that customers commonly use. I attached a short matrix and a spreadsheet with worked examples (see Cortexa_uplift_options_v1.xlsx). High level:

Option A — Smoothing (amortized uplift):
- Add committed capacity now; additional committed dollars are spread evenly across remaining term months.
- Applies standard uplift pricing but we can offer a one-time grace on unit price for the first 90 days if usage stabilizes.
- Good when Cortexa wants predictable monthly charges for budgeting.

Option B — Bucket-split (segregated uplift bucket):
- Create an incremental bucket that is billed separately at a negotiated uplift rate (usually slightly higher for true on-demand uplift).
- Option to convert the bucket to committed capacity at next co-term with a credit for prior spend.
- Good when you need immediate headroom and want to isolate experimental/seasonal spikes.

Preliminary discounting guidance (ballpark, subject to scope & term):
- Incremental annualized commitments >= 20%: standard banding reduces unit uplift by ~10-18% depending on term length.
- For mid-contract adds < 20%, we typically provide a modest bump (5-8%) and suggest co-term conversion for full banding.

I'll loop in Marissa from Commercial for a formal proposal and ben for any billing implications. Attached: one-pager and worked numbers. Can we align on a target uplift % or a range this week?

—Alex
